== Avatar Information ==
A Terrestrial Avatar, and creator of [[Dynamis]], the Shrouded Land. Diabolos aids the [[summoner]] with his command over the power of dreams.

[[Summoner]]s can acquire the ability to summon Diabolos by first defeating him in [[Chains of Promathia]] [[Darkness Named|Chapter 3-5: Darkness Named]], then defeating him a second time in the quest [[Waking Dreams]], which takes place in an uncapped battle that requires party members levels at the max level ingame idealy.
